GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Oral Expression, Active listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expression, Active listening.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Oral Expression, Active listening.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Oral Expression, Active listening.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Oral Expression, Active listening.

2. When practising Interactive Speaking, Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Interactive Speaking, Listening for Information.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Speaking, Listening for Information.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Interactive Speaking, Listening for Information.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive Speaking, Listening for Information.

3. When practising Active Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Active Listening.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Active Listening.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active Listening.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Active Listening.

4. “Guten Tag” means: (1 mark)
   A. Good day / hello
   B. Thank you
   C. Please
   D. Good night

5. When practising Oral Expression, Active Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Oral Expression, Active Listening.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Oral Expression, Active Listening.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expression, Active Listening.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Oral Expression, Active Listening.

6. German for “school” is: (1 mark)
   A. Haus
   B. Schule
   C. Buch
   D. Wasser

7. When practising Reading Aloud, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading Aloud.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Aloud.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading Aloud.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading Aloud.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
8. In three clear sentences, explain Reading Aloud and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

9. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

10. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

2. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Speaking, Listening for Information.

3. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active Listening.

4. A — Good day / hello

5. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expression, Active Listening.

11. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Guided Writing; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
